recent_articles.title: Kakatiya-era temple razed to make way for school, draws ire of historians - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The State Archaeology department** has been criticized for demolishing an 800-year-old temple in Warangal, Telangana. The temple, which featured a rare inscription referencing the Kakatiya ruler Ganapatdeva, was destroyed to make way for a government school.  Historians and activists have condemned the destruction, emphasizing that the temple could have been preserved or incorporated into the new construction.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet panel clears Railway Ministry’s three multitracking projects in six States - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs**, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved three multitracking projects for the **Railway Ministry** with a total cost of ₹23,437 crore. These projects will increase the existing railway network by about 901 km in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. The projects are expected to be completed by 2030-31 and will enhance connectivity to approximately 4,161 villages, improve rail connectivity to several tourist destinations, and provide seamless connectivity for people, goods, and services.

recent_articles.title: Anantapur police bust international cricket betting racket run from Philippines; 10 arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anantapur police** in India have arrested 10 individuals involved in an international cricket betting racket operating from the Philippines. The operation, led by **Superintendent of Police P Jagadeesh**, saw the seizure of ₹19.70 lakh in cash and ₹18.20 lakh in bank accounts across nine banks.  The gang, which has members across the country, used digital payment platforms to facilitate illegal betting activities through an app offering cricket betting and other banned games. The operation was initiated after police received information about the group's activities during the ongoing IPL matches. **Shiva**, a Philippines-based member of the gang, recruited local associates to collect bank accounts, SIM cards, and passbooks before sending them to the Philippines via cargo pants.

recent_articles.title: Requiem for Stalin’s spirit - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Joseph Stalin's** spirit appears to be perplexed and saddened by recent events in India, where his former followers have aligned with Hindu nationalism. The Communist Party of India-Marxist (CPI-M) has seen a decline in its influence, with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) gaining significant ground in West Bengal elections.  The CPI-M's support for Hindu nationalist forces is a surprise to Stalin's spirit, who would have preferred a more socialist approach. The writer notes that this shift reflects a broader trend of Indian communists aligning with Hindutva forces, a development that Stalin likely did not anticipate.

recent_articles.title: KTR accuses Revanth Reddy govt. of betrayal to 14L students over fee reimbursement - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, criticized the **Telangana Government** for delaying fee reimbursement payments to students from marginalized communities.  He accused the government of dismantling the scheme and causing financial distress in the education sector. **KTR** demanded the immediate withdrawal of the order and an apology from the Chief Minister. He also highlighted the impact on over 2,500 educational institutions and warned of statewide protests if the issue is not addressed.

recent_articles.title: TB dam crest gates repairs nearing completion, inauguration likely by May 15, says Shivakumar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister and Water Resources Minister of **Karnataka**, announced that the extensive repair and replacement of all 33 crest gates at the Tungabhadra Dam are nearing completion, with a target inauguration date set for May 15th.  The project, considered a technical marvel, has been completed ahead of schedule and will enhance the dam's lifespan by another 50 years. The state government is collaborating with **Andhra Pradesh** on the project, which aims to support agriculture in several regions across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.

recent_articles.title: Telangana sees more road accidents, fewer deaths in first quadrimester of 2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana** saw a mixed trend in road accident data for the first four months of 2026, with a rise in crashes and a decrease in fatalities.  While accidents increased by 2.5% to 9,313 between January and April this year, deaths fell to 2,363, marking a 15.3% decline from 2025. The **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** launched the ‘Arrive Alive’ campaign in January to promote responsible driving and reduce accidents and fatalities.  The state attributed the reduction in deaths to a comprehensive road safety action plan that includes stricter enforcement of traffic rules, checks on overloading, action against unfit and illegally modified vehicles, and improvements in post-crash response.

recent_articles.title: BRS office is a centre of ‘false propaganda’: Govt. Whip Adi Srinivas - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Adi Srinivas**, the **Congress** government whip, criticized the **BRS** government's handling of job creation in Telangana. He accused the BRS of misleading unemployed youth by failing to fill positions during its rule and now falsely claiming responsibility for recent job drives.  Srinivas highlighted the Congress government's transparency in providing nearly 70,000 jobs through recruitment ceremonies across Hyderabad.  He also criticized former **BRS** leader T. Jeevan Reddy for changing his stance on the issue after joining the party.

recent_articles.title: SCR seeks land at four locations in Telangana for mega coaching terminals - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **South Central Railway (SCR)** has requested the **Telangana** government to provide 1,125 acres of land for the development of mega coaching terminals. The sites identified include Dabilpur, Nagulapalli, Jukkal, and Cherlapally. These locations are intended to alleviate congestion at existing terminals and accommodate future passenger demands.

recent_articles.title: Telangana scorches as Mendora in Nizamabad hits 46℃; most districts record temperatures above 43℃ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana** experienced extreme heat on May 2nd, with temperatures reaching a high of 46°C in Mendora.  The **Telangana Development Planning Society (TGDPS)** reported that ten districts recorded maximum temperatures above 45°C. The highest temperature was recorded in Mendora, followed by other locations across the state.

recent_articles.title: Cut-off fixation is academic experts’ domain: HC - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana High Court** dismissed a writ petition filed by Kataru Satya Sai, who scored an overall percentile of 99.82 in the CAT-2025 exam. The court ruled that Satya Sai's request to be shortlisted for an MBA interview at **IIM-Mumbai** was based on a misunderstanding of the selection process, which is determined by mandatory sectional cut-offs set by the academic authorities.

recent_articles.title: Husnabad constituency witnessing all-round development: Ponnam Prabhakar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ponnam Prabhakar**, Minister for Backward Classes Welfare and Transport, announced plans to establish a **Telangana Public School** in Chigurumamidi and develop bus stands in Mulkanoor, Saidapur, and Elkaturthy.  He also highlighted ongoing infrastructure projects in Husnabad constituency, including the four-laning of Kothapalli-Husnabad main road and the Young India Integrated Residential School building at Tangellapalli. **Prabhakar** emphasized efforts to expedite the completion of the Gouravelli irrigation project and plans for a Kabaddi academy, ATC, and NAAC skill development training centers in the area.

recent_articles.title: Telangana Haj panel clarifies airfare hike, accommodation rules for pilgrims - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Syed Ghulam Afzal Biyabani**, chairman of the **Telangana Haj Committee (TGHC)**, stated that the additional ₹10,000 "differential airfare" for pilgrims was a decision made by the **Central government** and the **Haj Committee of India**.  He clarified that the TGHC would not permit pilgrims to cook at their accommodations in Saudi Arabia, instead requiring them to purchase food from approved catering companies or outside vendors.

recent_articles.title: Telangana government to clear ₹6,000 crore retirement benefits in 100 days, promises Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** assured government employees that the state would clear retirement benefits worth ₹6,000 crore within 100 days and announced a series of measures aimed at addressing employee welfare.  He highlighted key decisions made by his administration, including timely salary payments and free and transparent union elections.

recent_articles.title: Telangana MLAs, MPs asked to recommend CMRF cases only from their constituencies, applications not to be accepted otherwise - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana** government has implemented new guidelines for the Chief Minister’s Relief Fund (CMRF), requiring all applications to be submitted online and accompanied by a recommendation letter from a local MLA or Lok Sabha MP. The move aims to improve transparency and prevent misuse of the fund, as complaints arose about legislators outside their constituencies issuing letters, creating complications in processing relief.

recent_articles.title: Kavitha defends criticism of KCR, alleges attempts made to sabotage registration of her party - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Kavitha**, president of **Telangana Jagruthi**, defended her recent criticism of **K. Chandrashekar Rao**, the president of the **Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, stating that she holds ideological differences with him but maintains personal respect for him as a father. She argued that her party, **Telangana Rakshana Sena**, is being formed to provide an alternative political platform in Telangana and that the BJP cannot come to power in the state.  She also claimed that the previous BRS government caused "opportunity cost" to Telangana by failing to address issues like unemployment and job opportunities.

recent_articles.title: Commercial LPG 19 kg cylinder prices increase sharply, no change in domestic LPG cost - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **State-owned oil marketing companies** have announced a significant increase in commercial liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) prices, effective May 1, 2026. The price of 19 kg commercial cylinders has risen by almost ₹1,000 per refill to ₹3,315, marking an all-time high. This hike comes amid supply constraints due to the war in West Asia and government efforts to prioritize domestic LPG supplies. **The Telangana LPG Distributors Association (TLDA)** urged consumers to purchase from authorized distributors only, citing concerns about premium pricing and quality risks associated with unauthorized agents.

recent_articles.title: Govt. readying technical proposals for talks with Maharashtra on Pranahita-Chevella project - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Uttam Kumar Reddy**, **Minister for Irrigation and Civil Supplies** of **Telangana**, reaffirmed the government's commitment to reviving the Pranahita-Chevella project, aiming to provide irrigation to Adilabad and Rangareddy districts by constructing a barrage at Tummidihatti.  He instructed consultants from **Aarvee Associates** and **IIT Hyderabad** to prepare comprehensive technical proposals for consultation with **Maharashtra** regarding the construction of the barrage, emphasizing the need to minimize submergence in the Chapral wildlife sanctuary and offering appropriate compensation for affected lands.

recent_articles.title: Doctors’ body seeks cap on duty hours, flags 36-hour shifts for Telangana resident PG doctors - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Healthcare Reforms Doctors Association (HRDA)** in Telangana has written to the Director of Medical Education (DME) urging the implementation of regulated duty hours for resident doctors, senior residents, and interns. The association cites national standards and reports highlighting the negative impact of excessive working hours on trainee well-being, patient safety, and healthcare quality. They have requested the DME to issue directions mandating a maximum 12-hour shift and 48-hour workweek with weekly offs for all medical colleges in the state.

recent_articles.title: Doctors’ body seeks cap on duty hours, flags 36-hour shifts for Telangana resident PG doctors - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Healthcare Reforms Doctors Association (HRDA)** in Telangana has written to the Director of Medical Education (DME) requesting the implementation of regulated duty hours for resident doctors, senior residents, and interns across government and private medical colleges. The HRDA urged the DME to issue directions mandating a maximum of 12-hour shifts and 48-hour workweeks with weekly off days for all medical colleges in the state.

recent_articles.title: Telangana IT Minister for stronger digital push in govt. schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Sridhar Babu**, Minister for IT and Industries, visited a 'Super Summer Camp' in Manthani town to support the development of digital infrastructure in government schools. The camp, organized by **T-Fiber** and **Super Teacher Edu Reforms Pvt. Ltd.** aims to bridge the digital divide and provide hands-on learning experiences in computer education, AI, and robotics for students. Similar camps will be held in Peddapalli, Ramagundam, and Sulthanabad until May 23rd with a closing ceremony scheduled for May 26th.

recent_articles.title: Census 2027: Around 82 lakh households have opted for self enumeration as field visits begin in 5 states - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Union government** announced that over 82 lakh households have utilized the self-enumeration facility during the initial Houselisting and Housing Operations (HLO) phase of Census 2027. The exercise, which commenced on May 1st in several states including Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Rajasthan, aims to collect data about household facilities and demographics.  The HLO will continue until May 30th, with trained enumerators visiting each house for verification.

recent_articles.title: Buddha Purnima marked at Buddhavanam with ‘Mobile Museum on Wheels’ launch - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana Tourism and Culture Minister Jupally Krishna Rao** attended the 2570th Buddha Purnima celebrations at **Buddhavanam**, where traditional Buddhist rituals were performed.  The event included the inauguration of a children's play area and the launch of a "Mobile Museum on Wheels" initiative to promote Buddhist heritage education across Telangana. The mobile unit features replicas of Buddhist sculptures, educational materials, and digital content, aiming to foster understanding of Buddhist thought and values among younger generations.

recent_articles.title: HC issues contempt notices to top police officials, others over seizing two-wheeler for pending challans - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana High Court** issued notices to seven individuals, including former officials and police officers, in a contempt of court case concerning the seizure of a two-wheeler for non-payment of traffic challans. The case was filed by a private employee who argued that despite a previous HC order prohibiting such actions, traffic police continued seizing vehicles with pending challans.  The judge ordered these individuals to respond by June 19th.

recent_articles.title: Nearly ₹1,000 hike in commercial cylinder price is a harsh blow to cafes, hotels and street side vendors: Uttam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. The new price is ₹3,315, marking an increase of ₹994 from the previous ₹2,321. Reddy accused the **Centre** of taking the decision shortly after West Bengal elections, calling it "cheating" and demanding a rollback.

recent_articles.title: Mahua flower festival celebrated in Telangana’s Adilabad - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Adilabad Collector Rajarshi Shah** urged tribal communities to collect **ippa** flowers sustainably to enhance their economic well-being. He emphasized the importance of preserving trees and respecting tribal heritage, highlighting the significance of these efforts in achieving financial self-reliance. The call was made during the annual "Ippa Puvvu Panduga" event organized by the Integrated Tribal Development Agency, Utnoor, in collaboration with Adivasi (Gondwana) organizations at Jamidi village in Adilabad district.

recent_articles.title: City Nature Challenge 2026: Andhra, Telangana record surge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **East Coast Conservation Team** members and 15 enthusiasts participated in a tidepool exploration at Tenneti Park in Visakhapatnam last weekend. The group, including children as young as six, documented the diverse marine life they observed with photographs uploaded to iNaturalist.  The shared experience aimed to document nature's secrets along the shore.

recent_articles.title: High Court directs FRRO to extend Russian woman’s visa - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Justice Nagesh Bheemapaka** of the **Telangana High Court** granted a Russian woman, Alena Evgenievna Pavlova, an extension on her visa due to humanitarian and compassionate grounds. The judge also ruled against imposing overstay penalties on Pavlova, who had been actively involved in translating Indian literature into Russian and volunteering with various organizations.  The court acknowledged the exceptional circumstances of Pavlova's situation following the death of her husband and her subsequent request for an extension.

recent_articles.title: HC orders inquiry on ‘erring officers’ who did not act against illegal structures at Salkam cheruvu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Justice N.V. Shravan Kumar** of the Telangana High Court ordered a detailed inquiry into construction violations at the Barrister Fatima Owaisi Education Campus within the Full Tank Level/buffer zone of Salkam Cheruvu. The **HYDRAA**, **Municipal Administration and Urban Development**, **GHMC**, and **HMDA** were instructed to report by July 7th on how officials permitted structures in the buffer zone.  The judge also directed the **School Education department** to ensure students are not disturbed.

recent_articles.title: Telangana Govt extends Prajavani to RDO level with immediate effect - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana Government** has expanded its Prajavani public grievance redressal initiative to the revenue division level, with weekly sessions conducted by sub-collectors or revenue divisional officers. The program will be phased out to the mandal level in the future.  The initiative mandates registration of grievances online and provides a dedicated portal for tracking and monitoring resolution progress. **District Collectors** oversee district-level Prajavani sessions, where all department officers are present to address citizen concerns.

recent_articles.title: DGP Shivadhar Reddy to be made TS State Security Advisor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B. Shivadhar Reddy**, the outgoing Director General of Police, is expected to be appointed as **Telangana’s State Security Advisor** in the rank of Chief Secretary. This move comes after the government named **C.V. Anand** as the new DGP and follows a pattern of previous appointments where retired IPS officers have been given advisory roles.  The appointment marks a departure from past practice, making it the first such position for a retired IPS officer.

recent_articles.title: CV Anand calls on Telangana CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C.V. Anand**, the newly appointed **Director General of Police**, met with **Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** at the Integrated Command Control Centre (ICCC) in Hyderabad on Wednesday.  Anand thanked Reddy for the opportunity to serve as DGP and assured him he would work diligently to enhance safety and security. The incumbent DGP, **B. Shivadhar Reddy**, is set to demit office on Thursday.

recent_articles.title: Siberian Huskies abandoned on Hyderabad outskirts, found severely dehydrated; one dead, eight traced - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Animal Shelter for Rescue Aid (AASRA)** and **Shakuntala Society for Animal Welfare and Nature (SWAN)** rescued at least eight Siberian huskies abandoned along the Shankarpally–Patancheru road near Bhanur village. Rescuers found the dogs dehydrated and disoriented, with some estimates suggesting over 30 animals may have been abandoned in the area. The dogs are estimated to be between two and three years old and were left without access to shade or water during peak summer conditions, raising concerns about potential unethical breeding practices or laboratory testing.  Rescue efforts continue as police investigate the incident.

recent_articles.title: Global giant Heineken’s GCC in Hyderabad inaugurated - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Heineken** inaugurated its global capability center (GCC) in Hyderabad, India. Sridhar Babu** inaugurated the center on Wednesday (April 29, 2026).

recent_articles.title: Telangana to deploy AI based system for surveillance operations in Amrabad tiger reserve - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana** government has issued a request for proposal (RFP) to deploy an AI-based forest and wildlife surveillance system on a pilot basis. The system aims to improve monitoring efficiency of the **Forest Department**, conserve tigers and other wildlife, identify poaching or crime-prone areas, and check infiltration, illegal mining, and provide data for decision making.  The solution will be implemented in a hybrid model using normal cameras and thermal sensing, with a wireless network connecting all cameras to a control room that generates alerts and provides reports on wildlife movement patterns.

recent_articles.title: TGGENCO gets ISO Certification - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TGGENCO**, the **Telangana State Power Generation Corporation**, has received international recognition for its commitment to quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement by achieving the prestigious ISO 9001:2015 certification. The certification was presented by **Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka** to the organization’s Chairman and Managing Director, **Harish**, in the presence of **Energy Special Chief Secretary Naveen Mittal**.  The recognition was awarded following a comprehensive audit conducted by an independent ISO certification body.

recent_articles.title: BRS to hold farmers’ meet in Warangal on May 6: KTR - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BRS** working president K.T. Rama Rao announced a meeting in Warangal on May 6th to remind the **Congress party** of its "Rythu Declaration" and alleged failures to fulfill promises made four years ago.  Rama Rao expressed concern over farmer distress caused by fertilizer shortages, delayed procurement, and power cuts. He urged farmers to be prepared for struggles to pressure the government into fulfilling their promises.

recent_articles.title: Special Passport Mela on May 9; 4,000 appointments to be released in Telangana: RPO Hyderabad - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Regional Passport Office (RPO), Hyderabad**, is hosting a special Passport Mela on May 9th to address the growing demand for passport services. The event will offer 4,000 normal passport appointments across all five **Passport Seva Kendras (PSKs)** under its jurisdiction, aiming to reduce the current waiting period of 8 to 10 working days.  **J. Snehaja**, Regional Passport Officer, Hyderabad, also announced a significant capacity enhancement at the Karimnagar PSK, increasing daily appointment slots from 220 to 400. Applicants are advised to apply online through 'www.passportindia.gov.in' and utilize the additional appointment slots.

recent_articles.title: Problems in land transactions continue to persist a year after passage of Bhu Bharati Act - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A year after the enactment of **Telangana Bhu Bharati (Record of Rights) Act, 2025**, farmers continue to face challenges in securing land rights.  The recent suicide of farmer Madhav Rao in Sangareddy district highlights these difficulties, as he reportedly took his life due to pressure from family members following a land transfer through a "plain paper transaction" without their knowledge.

recent_articles.title: Mukunda Reddy takes charge as I&PR Special Commissioner - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Mukunda Reddy** assumed the role of Special Commissioner and Ex-officio Secretary of the **State Information and Public Relations Department**, succeeding **C.H. Priyanka**.  He emphasized the importance of disseminating government welfare programs to the public, urging officials to follow directives set by Chief Minister **A. Revanth Reddy** and Minister for Revenue, Housing, Information and Public Relations **Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy**. The event was attended by senior officials from the department.

recent_articles.title: Government signs MoU with State Legal Services Authority to promote legal awareness and child protection in schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The State government** and **Telangana State Legal Services Authority (TSLSA)** signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen legal literacy and child protection in schools. The initiative, implemented across 5,711 high schools, will include legal awareness sessions for students and teachers, awareness campaigns on child rights, and the establishment of legal literacy and child rights clubs.  The program also includes training for teachers, provision of legal aid and counselling services, and efforts to support school dropouts. The MoU is in effect for two years with a potential extension.
